title: Does protein before bed build muscle while you sleep? 🌙
caption:
About 40 g of slow-digesting casein before sleep is digested and used overnight. But when total daily protein is the same, the timing makes little difference. Hit your daily total first. Do you eat before bed? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Supplement Series, Part 13
